snippet.title: Little Monster | Official Gameplay Trailer #1
snippet.description:
Here's our first game play trailer for Little Monster!

A hand painted side scroller beat 'em up game where you play as the monster under the bed, Stormy, protecting the neighborhood kids from their nightmares.

The game is set to launch in 2025.

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2503620/Little_Monster/

#indiegame #pcgaming #beatemupgames #2d #steamgames
